title: Bijectivity of the localized cycle component function
statement: For C,J,R,U,L,I and zero-preserving slice restriction as in [def-pur-hom-complex], let S be the evaluated Hom complex with chosen projections pi. Every function f from S.cycles 0 to chain maps res(L) → res(I) satisfying the projection formula on every cycle, degree and slice object is bijective. The existence of such a function is not asserted here.

proof.text: Use the product cone of homComplex_exists in degree zero. Section evaluation, followed by forget to types, preserves this cone by Mathlib SheafOfModules.forgetPreservesLimitsOfShape and the evaluation and module forgetful instances. For cycles z,z′ with f z=f z′, the prescribed formulas imply equality of every internal-Hom projection on every slice object. PresheafOfModules.hom_ext gives equality of the projected sections. Apply the evaluated limit’s hom_ext to the constant functions from PUnit to the two included cycles, then use AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective for iCycles to get z=z′.

Given a localized chain map g, apply the cycle-lifting theorem to obtain z with the prescribed component projections. The formula for f z and the lifting formula give equality of all components on all slice objects. Extensionality of complexes, sheaf morphisms and presheaf module morphisms gives f z=g. Combine injectivity and surjectivity.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0A8X before 0A8Y; K2 formalizes product injectivity and reduces surjectivity to cycle lifting

lean.statement:
theorem localizedHomComplex_cycles_bijective
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hzero : Functor.PreservesZeroMorphisms
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) U)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
    let H := homComplex (R := R) L I
    let π := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (homComplex_exists.{u, v, max u v, max u v} (J := J) (R := R)))
    let S := ((SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H
    letI := hzero
    let res : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} R₀) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R₀.over U)) ℤ :=
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    ∀ f : S.cycles 0 → (res.obj L ⟶ res.obj I),
      (∀ (z : S.cycles 0) (p : ℤ) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ),
        ((f z).f p).val.app W =
          (((π L I 0 p p (add_zero p)).val.app (op U)) (S.iCycles 0 z)).app W) →
      Function.Bijective f
